desc: Implement binary search over L in [1, n] with feasibility check `can(L)` (L==1: min flips to either alternating pattern; L≥2: sum of len//(L+1) over maximal runs) inside `Solution.minLength`.
Verify against examples: "000001"/1 → 2, "0000"/2 → 1, "0101"/0 → 1, plus edge cases numOps=0, numOps≥n, n=1, all-same strings.
Cross-check the len//(L+1) formula against a brute-force O(n·L) DP on small random strings to confirm optimality for L≥2; if it fails, replace check with the DP.
Finalize code in the required `Solution.minLength` format with brief complexity note.
